string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: New Games screen, console style: the focused game shows big with its official logo, one row with the last played first (OK plays), and the home screen Games card shows the last game

The TV as a network drive: its storage opens in Windows (Map network drive), Mac, Linux and phone file apps over WebDAV, with the panel PIN as password; it also shows up in Windows Network (Settings › Remote access, off by default)
Player: the top of the column just says TV, Movies or Series, with Search and Filter buttons beside it; the list makes room for Recordings (TV: Favorites, Recent, Guide, Recordings)
Games card on the home screen, after Network: GeForce NOW, Steam Link, Moonlight, PS Remote Play, RetroArch and the other games leave the apps row and sit in 4 groups
Games: “Play on the PC” wakes the computer and opens Moonlight or Steam Link; “Test the network” tells whether cloud gaming will work; connected controllers show at the top
Game mode: while a game is open, the screensaver, night filter and notices wait
Web panel: Settings tab with theme, text size, audio, screensaver, parental control, kids and guest mode, kids’ PIN, change PIN and Confirmations, the same as on the TV
Web panel: connect the Google Drive account (code and QR right in the panel), disconnect it and restore a Drive copy, just like in the TV Settings
Real volume on LG NetCast TVs (2013) over the network: sleep timer, bedtime limit, voice and alarm
Series: 10-second countdown before the next episode, “Still watching?” after 3 in a row, and “Turn off the TV when this ends” in the ▼ menu
Movies and series try again by themselves when the connection drops, subtitle size in the ▼ menu, and the details page works offline
Screensaver answers the remote: ◀ ▶ move through the cards, OK dismisses a notice or pauses the music, and a “now playing” card
Screensaver photos from a network folder (computer, NAS or Nextcloud): open the folder in “Network” and choose “Use these photos”
More apps on the home screen now show a short description under their name
Search: at the end of the results, continue the same search on YouTube, Netflix or Prime Video
Live TV: each account can have a second XMLTV guide that only fills channels left without a schedule
“My team” reminders now see matches up to 7 days ahead, not just the next 14 hours
Up to 3 named timers at once, plus a stopwatch (Hourglass); Home shows the next one
Alarms can wake you with the last live TV channel (a radio from your list works too)
Kids PIN: unlock channels and bedtime without giving away the panel PIN
Daily screen time: when it runs out, only allowed apps open (Extras)
Calendar with all the TV\'s Google accounts together
“Network” looks like a catalog: poster and synopsis beside the list, Recently added, Search on Jellyfin, Emby and Plex, and a folder plays the next video or song
Settings: each Extras switch now lives in its own tab, under “More options”
Settings: lines with a QR code that opens the web panel straight on scenes, Home Assistant, photos, family board, my team or router
Quick panel: choose its tiles and their order (Settings > Appearance), with new Night filter and DNS tiles
Type with accents from your phone and from Claude (ç, ã, é arrive as typed)
Guest Wi-Fi as a QR: Settings > Guests and routines; in guest mode, Wi-Fi in the quick panel shows the QR
The nightly backup now checks every night that the saved copy would restore
Settings > System > What gets used: screens and settings by use, counted only on this TV
Internet: a phone alert when it comes back (how long it was down and the likely cause), a monthly summary in the panel, and an alert when storage is filling up
Quick panel: the TV\'s latest alerts (rain, notes, maintenance) and the shopping list, crossed out with OK
Movies and series follow the TV’s language: “dubbed” means audio in that language, and automatic and online subtitles come in it too
Series: mark the opening once in the ▼ menu (start and end) and the next episodes offer “Skip opening · OK”
Settings reorganized by subject: Home screen, TV and movies, Family, Screen and power, Home and automations, Remote access, System; the technical part went to Advanced
The “Hidden” card left the home screen: show hidden apps again in Settings › Home screen › Hidden apps
Movies and Series also for M3U-only lists: the list\'s movies and episodes become a catalog
Home: light color and temperature (while adjusting brightness, ▲ ▼ change the tone)
Read aloud what has the focus, on every launcher screen (Settings › Home screen › More options)
Suggestions at the right time, no AI: after late nights the home screen offers to turn the TV off by itself or turn on the night filter
Share to the TV from your phone: YouTube videos open in YouTube, links open on the TV, text becomes a message (web panel installed as an app)
TV diary: 7 days of what changed the TV (web panel, Claude, adb, the TV itself), in the web panel and for Claude; it can also call a link of yours
When a text box opens on the TV, your phone can get “Type on the TV” (web panel notifications)
A new AI app can sign in without waiting for an update: allow its domain in the web panel
One text size for every screen: Settings › Home screen › Text size (Normal, Large, Larger)
Live TV: the channel list and the guide use the launcher’s colors and line icons (star, recents, search, filters, guide, lock)
Movies: Filter (genre, period, minimum rating, only unwatched) over the chosen category, “Collection of this movie” in the details, and “Surprise me”
Phone panel: a “Ask the TV” box on the Home tab, no AI: “put on Globo”, “open YouTube”, “remind me in 7 minutes”, “turn off in 30 minutes” (the keyboard mic works for dictating)
“My team”: the next match in the next 24 hours shows up next to the alarm and timer at the top of the Home screen and as a card on the Gallery screensaver (“Flamengo × Palmeiras · 21:30”)
Install split apps (.apks, .xapk) from the web panel or Claude; the TV picks the parts for its own chip
Curated store: add any GitHub project that publishes its APK; the TV picks the file for its architecture
App sheets and the cleanup list can grow with community contributions (checked once a week)
Home screen: temperature, humidity, door, motion, water and smoke sensors, and the air conditioner (hold OK to set the temperature)
Home screen: cameras show their picture of right now on the TV with OK (also from the web panel and Claude)
Voice: “Ok Google, open Movies” (also Series, Network media, Home control, Search, Board) opens that launcher screen
Live TV: pause any channel for up to 2 minutes (⏯, or ▶ ▶ › “Pause live TV”); OK resumes from where you stopped, ▶ goes back to live. Kept only in the player\'s memory, never on disk
The web panel is in English when the phone or computer is not in Portuguese
With the TV in English, voice requests for channels ("watch Globo", "what's on SBT") work in English too, and the confirmations show up in English
LG volume: the alarm never goes above 30, the volume is checked after each change, and the alarm on the LG starts turned off

Real profiles: each Google account on the TV has its own channel favorites, Continue watching, last episodes, watchlist and app order; a profile can be marked as a kid profile (quick panel), which turns on kids mode and bedtime and asks the parents\' PIN to leave
The launcher has its own icon and banner (in Apps and in Settings)
"Now playing" pill on the top bar of the home screen: cover, title and app; OK pauses or resumes, hold OK opens the app (turn on "Now playing" in Extras)
Settings › Help: a manual of everything the launcher does, in 16 topics (remote, home screen, quick panel, voice, TV, movies, family, home, web panel, Claude, backup and more); ◀ ▶ switch topics
Live TV, Movies and Series have a new column: fixed actions on top (Search, Filter, Watchlist/Favorites, Continue/Recent, Watched/Guide), then “LISTS” with All pinned and the categories from A to Z
Live TV: a pinned “Sports” below All, gathering football, fights and the like, with whatever is live right now first
Movies and Series: a single Filter (sort, genre/era/rating, unwatched only, surprise me and show hidden); the screen reopens on the last category and shows “+N” on categories with new titles

Finished now counts by what is left: under 10 min for a movie, under 3 min for an episode; starting the next episode finishes the previous one; holding OK on a poster marks it watched or removes it from Continue
Series in the Watchlist get a label: green “Finished” and yellow “New season” or “N new episodes”
Movies and Series: the top of the screen shows the category, the count and the active filters as pills, plus the focused title\'s rating, year, length, genre and 2 lines of synopsis, in large letters
Movies and Series: in a big category, ▶ on the last column (or Filter › “Go to a letter”) jumps straight to a letter
Live TV › Sports: channels with a match or fight live right now get a red “LIVE” label and come first
After the launcher updates itself (even overnight), the TV wakes up on our home screen, no longer stuck on Google\'s until you open the launcher once
Easier subtitles: black background behind the text and yellow subtitles, in the ▼ menu of movies and series and in Settings › TV and movies
“Even volume between channels” and “Clearer voices” in the player menu (live TV, movies and series) and in Settings › TV and movies: quiet sound gets louder and speech comes forward
With simple mode on, live TV, Movies and Series open on Favorites or Continue, with fewer rows and larger text
Movies and series with Dolby (AC3, E-AC3), DTS or TrueHD sound now play with sound even with “Even volume” or “Clearer voices” on; channels with MP2 audio too
Blu-ray and DVD subtitles (PGS, VobSub) now show in movies and series, and anime ASS subtitles keep their original colour and position
Network: folders over FTP, FTPS, SFTP and NFS (NAS, router with a drive, Linux or Mac computer), and a USB drive plugged into the TV shows up by itself under “Plugged into the TV”

Live TV records to a USB drive or disk on the hub (or a Windows/NAS folder): ▶▶ › Record on a channel, OK on a future show in the guide to schedule it (also every week), and the Recordings screen in the live TV column
On the network: OneDrive and Dropbox as a source of videos, music and photos (once, you create your own app at the service and sign in from your phone)
Subtitles in the same folder as the video (Movie.srt, Movie.pt-BR.ass) show up in ▼ by themselves, in network folders, the cloud and USB drives
Movies and series at their own frame rate: the TV switches to 24 Hz and the picture does not judder in camera moves (Settings › TV and movies, ▼ menu and panel)
On the network: Box and Google Drive as sources too (you create the app at the service once; to sign in, a phone on the same Wi‑Fi scans the QR and comes back to the TV by itself)

string-array.name: roteiro_titulos
string-array.item: Network drive
Search and Filter at the top of the column
Press HOME and go to the end of the WATCH AND PLAY row
Open the Games card and move along the games row
On the Games screen, press Test the network
In the web panel, change the theme in the Settings tab
In the web panel, open the Backup tab
Press HOME
Open Home from the quick panel
Open Settings > Automations
Open Scenes from the quick panel, or say “Ok Google, open Scenes”
Tap, hold and double tap a free button on the remote
Make a test scene for “movie paused”, then pause a movie
Let an episode reach the end (or skip to the last minute)
Play music, wait for the screensaver, then press ◀ ▶ and OK
In “Network”, open a folder with photos and choose “Use these photos in the screensaver”
On the home screen, move to an app you installed (e.g. a file manager)
Open Search, type a movie name and pick “Search … on YouTube” at the end
In the panel, add an account with a second guide link, then open Live TV
With your team saved in “My team”, open Live TV once, then look at the reminders in the panel
Say “Ok Google, open Avisar em 5 minutos”, then “open Avisar em 10 minutos”
Say “Ok Google, open Ampulheta” and pick Start stopwatch
In a test alarm, set Sound: Last live TV channel
Settings > Parental control > Kids PIN; then show a hidden category with it
Extras: turn on Daily screen time with 30 min and open an app
Open the calendar (OK on the date at the top)
In “Network”, open a Jellyfin or Plex server, try Search and Recently added, and play a video from a folder
Open Settings > Screen and power and go to the end
Open Settings > Guests and routines > Scenes from your phone, and scan the code
In Settings > Appearance > Quick panel tiles, show Night filter and move it to the top; then hold HOME
Type “ação” in the TV search from the phone panel
Set Settings > Guests and routines > Guest Wi-Fi, turn guest mode on and press Wi-Fi in the quick panel
Settings > System > Automatic backup > Back up now
Open Settings > System > What gets used
Open the quick panel and scroll to the bottom
Play a foreign movie set to “Original with subtitles” (TV in Portuguese)
In an episode, use ▼ to mark the opening start and end, then open the next episode
Open Settings and go down the tab menu
Hide an app (hold OK on it), then open Settings › Home screen › Hidden apps and press OK on it
In Home, hold OK on a color light and press ▲ ▼
Turn on Settings › Home screen › More options › Read aloud what has the focus, then move through Settings
On the phone, share a YouTube video to “One TV”
In the web panel, Extras > TV diary > Show the diary
Turn on the notification “Text box open on the TV” and open the YouTube search on the TV
In the web panel, Connect an AI > Another AI app: allow a test domain
Set Settings › Home screen › Text size to Larger, then open the quick panel and Movies
In live TV, open the channel list (OK) and then the Guide
In Movies, use Filter (e.g. a genre + rating 7+), then Surprise me, then “Collection of this movie” in a sequel’s details
In the phone panel (Home tab), type “open YouTube” in “Ask the TV”
With a “My team” word that has a match in the next 24 hours, press HOME
In the web panel, Apps > Install: send a .xapk file
In the web panel, Extras > Curated store: add a GitHub project (e.g. owner/name) and install it
In the web panel, open the sheet of an app
Open the Home screen (Home Assistant) and find a sensor or the air conditioner
On the Home screen, press OK on a camera
Say “Ok Google, open Movies” (and the others: Series, Network media, Home control, Search, Board)
On a live channel without catch-up, ▶ ▶ › “Pause live TV”, wait 1 minute and press OK; then ▶ › “Back to live”
Open the web panel on a browser set to English
With the TV in English, say "what's on" and a channel name
In the quick panel, open the profiles, mark one account as “Kid profile” (parents\' PIN) and switch to it; favorite a channel; then switch back to your profile
Open Settings > Apps and find One TV Launcher
Play a song or video, go back to the home screen and press OK on the pill
Open Settings › Help and press OK on “The remote”; then press ▶ a few times and ▼
Open Movies and go down the left column to the categories
Open Live TV, press OK and choose Sports
In Movies, hold OK on a started poster and choose “Mark as watched”
Open Movies › All and move along a few posters
In Movies › All, go to the last column and press ▶, then choose a letter
The next time you turn the TV on, after this version installed
In a movie with subtitles, ▼ › turn on “Subtitles with black background” and “Yellow subtitles”
In live TV, ▶ ▶ › turn on “Even volume between channels” and switch between a quiet and a loud channel
In a movie with quiet dialogue, ▼ › turn “Clearer voices” on and off
Turn on “Clearer voices” in ▼ and open a movie with Dolby or DTS sound (from On the network or Movies)
Open an MKV movie with Blu-ray (PGS) subtitles or an anime with ASS subtitles and turn subtitles on in ▼
Plug a USB drive with videos into the TV and open Network
With a USB drive on the hub, on a channel: ▶▶ › Record 1 hour; after 2 min, OK › Recordings in the column
In the guide, OK on a show starting in 10 min › Record; turn the TV off and wait for it to end
In On the network › OneDrive (or Dropbox), follow the steps and open a video from the cloud
Open a movie and watch a scene where the camera pans slowly
In Network › Box (then Google Drive), follow the steps on a computer and point a phone (on the home Wi‑Fi) at the QR

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: With Settings › Remote access › Show the TV as a network drive on, does Windows Map network drive with the address shown there and the panel PIN open the TV folders?
In TV, Movies and Series, does ▲ on the first row reach the Search and Filter buttons beside the title, and ▼ go back to the list?
Is there an amber Games card after Network?
Does the focused game show big, with its official logo, and does ◀ ▶ on the row below switch it right away, last played first?
Does the top say whether the network is good for cloud gaming, with the time in ms?
Did the TV home screen switch to the chosen theme?
Does “Google Drive account” show with connect, and do the code and QR show in the panel?
Did it go back to the home screen?
Are the cards grouped by room, clear of the hints at the bottom?
Do your routines and alarms show up there, and can you edit one?
Did the Scenes list open?
Did each one do what you set for it?
Did the test scene run?
Did “Next episode” count down from 10, and did Cancel keep you on the series page?
Did the cards get highlighted and did OK pause the music?
Did those photos show up in the next screensaver?
Does the line under its name say what it does, in the TV’s language?
Did YouTube open with that search (or at least open)?
Do channels that had no schedule now show programs, while the others stay the same?
Does a match more than a day away show up in the list?
Does the Home pill show the nearest timer with “+1”?
Does the pill show the stopwatch counting up, and does OK on it stop it and show the time?
At alarm time, did the channel play, getting louder slowly?
Did the kids PIN unlock it, and does the panel PIN still work?
After 30 min, did the app go back to Home with the notice?
Do events from all the TV\'s accounts show up?
Did the poster and synopsis show up, and did the next video start after 10 s?
Are Night filter, Gentle shutdown and the other switches there, under “More options”?
Did the phone open the panel already on the Scenes card?
Is Night filter the first tile of the panel?
Did it arrive with the ç and the ã?
Did the QR show up, and did a phone camera connect?
Does the result say “restore check passed”?
Do the screens you opened today show up?
Do the TV alerts and the shopping list show, and does OK cross out an item?
Did Portuguese subtitles turn on by themselves, as before?
Did “Skip opening · OK” show up in the opening, and did OK jump past it without pausing?
Is it easier to find things, with the technical part only in Advanced?
No “Hidden” card on the home screen, and the app came back?
Did the light change tone?
Did the TV say the name of each line, without talking over itself?
Did the video open in YouTube on the TV?
Do today’s actions show up?
Did the phone get “Type on the TV”, and did tapping it open the Remote tab?
Was it saved and listed?
Did the text grow and still fit, with nothing cut off?
Do Favorites, Recents, Search, Filters and Guide show line icons (no squares or emoji), with the same sizes as before?
Did the column title show the filter, did the pick open a movie from the filtered grid, and did the collection list the sequels?
Did the panel answer “Opening YouTube” and did YouTube open on the TV?
Did the match show up next to the alarm/timer at the top, with the start time?
Did the app install and open?
Did it install the right file?
Does the sheet still show?
Does the value show, and does holding OK on the air conditioner change the temperature?
Did the picture show over the screen?
Did each one open the right screen (and not another app)?
Did it resume where it stopped with “1 MIN BEHIND”, and did “Back to live” jump to now?
Are the tabs and buttons in English?
Did the answer come in English?
Did kids mode and bedtime turn on in the kid profile, did leaving ask for the PIN, and did your favorites come back as before?
Does it show the ring with the play symbol?
Did it pause, and did it resume with OK again?
Can you read the text from the couch, did ◀ ▶ switch topics and did ▼ scroll to the end?
Did the top block stay put, “All” too, and only the categories (A to Z) scroll?
Did the channels with a live game or fight come first?
Did the movie leave Continue and go to Watched with the green label?
Did the top show the pills and the quick info (with synopsis after a moment), readable from the couch?
Did the big letters open and the grid jump to that letter?
Did it open on the One TV home screen (not Google\'s), and does HOME bring it back?
Are the subtitles yellow on a black band, easy to read from the couch?
Did the quiet channel get closer to the others, without hiss or distortion?
With it on, was speech easier to understand?
Did the movie play with sound (before it was silent)?
Did the subtitle show complete, in the right place and in sync?
Does the drive show under “Plugged into the TV” and does a video from it play?
Did the channel keep playing smoothly, and does the recording show up and play in Recordings?
Afterwards, is the whole show in Recordings?
Did the video play, and could you skip forward and back without stalling?
Did the screen blink black at the start, and was the motion smooth, without stutter?
After allowing access, did the phone say “Done” and the Box (and Drive) folder open on the TV, with a video playing?
